description: Implement reviewed design exports and interaction specifications with explicit responsive and accessibility contracts.
instructions: Record design document and revision, frame IDs, export scale, font files, authorized assets, content and design owner. Extract tokens and component variants before implementation.

Identify unspecified behavior, intermediate breakpoints, empty/loading/error states, focus order and accessible names. Resolve these in the task contract rather than claiming they are inferable from a screenshot.

Map every approved frame and interaction state to a scenario and viewport. Import original exported PNGs as independent references; provide expected landmark geometry/text from design measurements for each viewport.
Implement tokens, reusable components, responsive composition and interactions. Use real text and semantic controls; the visual baseline does not replace behavior or accessibility checks.
Compare every required frame/state against the approved image, text and geometry. Use regions for diagnostic detail and add full-page cases to expose missing content and overflow.

Keep design-export provenance distinct from browser-capture provenance. Explain rasterization differences and review calibrated tolerances; never regenerate a design baseline from the candidate to make it pass.
